msg.content: Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?
Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?

content.content: The user asks: "Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?" Big Five likely refers to Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google (Alphabet), and Facebook (Meta). Provide locations: Apple - Cupertino, California; Microsoft - Redmond, Washington; Amazon - Seattle, Washington (HQ2 in Arlington, Virginia but primary HQ Seattle); Google (Alphabet) - Mountain View, California; Meta (Facebook) - Menlo Park, California. Provide maybe addresses. Should answer concisely.

content:
**Big Five technology companies – headquarters locations**

| Company | Parent/Corporate name | Headquarters city & state (USA) | Notable campus address |
|---------|----------------------|----------------------------------|------------------------|
| **Apple** | Apple Inc. | Cupertino, California | Apple Park, 1 Apple Park Way, Cupertino, CA 95014 |
| **Microsoft** | Microsoft Corp. | Redmond, Washington | Microsoft Redmond Campus, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, WA 98052 |
| **Amazon** | Amazon.com, Inc. | Seattle, Washington (primary) – also a second major campus in Arlington, Virginia (HQ2) | Amazon Spheres & Day 1 Building, 410 Terry Ave N, Seattle, WA 98109 |
| **Google (Alphabet)** | Alphabet Inc. (Google LLC) | Mountain View, California | Googleplex, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043 |
| **Meta** (formerly Facebook) | Meta Platforms, Inc. | Menlo Park, California | Meta Campus, 1 Hacker Way, Menlo Park, CA 94025 |

These locations are the primary corporate headquarters where the executive leadership and core corporate functions are based. (Amazon’s “HQ2” in Arlington, VA, is an additional major office but the original Seattle campus remains the flagship headquarters.)
